key_insight: Compatible sparse-grid finite elements discretize BGG complexes with stable discrete potentials and dimension-independent convergence rates under mixed Sobolev regularity.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports efficient discretizations of elasticity and higher-order mechanics problems with fewer degrees of freedom than full tensor-product grids.
method: Build compatible polynomial hierarchies from Alpert wavelets and their first and second primitives.
Construct a bounded commuting sparse-grid projection for Hessian, elasticity, and div-div complexes.
Prove approximation estimates under mixed Sobolev regularity.
evidence_signal: Experiments on a 3D incompatibility problem and a 2D biharmonic problem on an annulus illustrate efficiency relative to full grids.
watch_item: The convergence guarantees require mixed Sobolev regularity, which should be checked for problems with singularities or limited smoothness.
